a1-29.title: Communicative Challenge: Grandparents
a1-29.scenario: You and Meg are looking at a family picture. Meg points to a woman and a man in it and asks who they are.
a1-29.prompt: Tell Meg the woman is your grandmother and the man is your grandfather.
a1-29.target: Ő a nagymamám. A férfi a nagypapám.
a1-29.english: She is my grandmother. The man is my grandfather.
a1-29.canDo: I can introduce my grandparents: nagymama, nagypapa.
